scoring_justification: Checker recomputes peak positions and relative intensities from the raw Raman spectrum CSV and overtone contribution CSV, comparing to hidden gold derived from the paper's Fig. 5 and associated text.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold reference for peak positions and relative intensities of the five major two-phonon Raman bands at $E_L=2.33$ eV.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Fig. 5 (high-frequency region) and Fig. 8 (mid-frequency region), along with descriptions in Sections 3.3 and 3.4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Peak positions estimated from the figures (2TO@K ~2685 cm⁻¹, 2LO@\Gamma ~3245 cm⁻¹, TOLA@K ~2450 cm⁻¹, LOZO'@\Gamma ~1720 cm⁻¹, TOZO'@K ~1880 cm⁻¹). Relative intensities derived from the band intensity ratios described in the paper (high : mid : low = 5000 : 50 : 1) and approximate band heights: 2TO@K 1.0, 2LO@\Gamma 0.08, TOLA@K 0.02, LOZO'@\Gamma 0.006, TOZO'@K 0.004.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Grounded in the paper's reported spectra; tolerances are generous to absorb legitimate implementation differences while excluding random guesses.

outputs.description: Full two-phonon Raman spectrum at laser excitation energy 2.33 eV. The checker recomputes peak positions and intensities from this file.

units.intensity: arb. units (normalized same as full spectrum)

outputs.description: Overtone-only contribution to the 2D band region. Checker validates consistency with the full spectrum (peak positions must match).
Agent-reported peak positions and relative intensities of five major two-phonon Raman bands, directly compared to hidden gold values within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: All output files are required. The checker may also recompute peaks from the submitted CSV spectra to cross-validate the reported values.
